features.feature_instruction: The Shared (Backend) feature provides foundational error handling and response structures for the entire application. It defines a standard `ErrorResponse` DTO for consistent API error messages, a `ResourceNotFoundException` for common 'resource not found' scenarios, and a `GlobalExceptionHandler` to centralize exception handling across all controllers. The `GlobalExceptionHandler` will catch `ResourceNotFoundException` and return an `ErrorResponse` with an HTTP 404 status. It will also catch general `Exception` types and return a generic `ErrorResponse` with an HTTP 500 status, ensuring no sensitive internal details are exposed. Other features will throw `ResourceNotFoundException` when an entity is not found, and the `GlobalExceptionHandler` will automatically translate this into a standardized error response.
